algorithm: Gradient Boosted Trees (attack vs normal) + Random Forest (normal/DoS/Probe/R2L/U2R) + Isolation Forest trained on normal traffic (zero-day novelty)

dataset.name: NSL-KDD (KDDTrain+ / KDDTest+)
dataset.note: Only the 28 header-derivable features are used (13 payload/content features excluded) so live pcap traffic yields the same vector. R2L/U2R attacks are mostly visible only in payloads, so their recall is low by design.
dataset.split: official KDDTest+ (contains attack types absent from training)

task: Network intrusion detection on connection records reconstructed from pcap / live capture
